newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS END FIRMER BUT GAP TO BUNDS WIDENS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS END FIRMER BUT GAP TO BUNDS WIDENS.

text.p: 1630/1430 GMT - Bonds end on a firmer note as U.S. inflation
seen under control after Jan PPI drops 0.3 pct, below forecasts,
dealers say. But markka bonds underperform Bunds as broad
overseas debt rally fails to catch wind. Scope seen for tighter
yield gap to Bunds. Markka ends steady, seen in 2.91-2.96 range.
*FIM-06 yld pct 5.87 vs 5.91 *06 gap over Bund bps 39 vs 35
*FIM-04 yld pct 5.43 vs 5.49 *FIM-99 yld pct 3.54 vs 3.59
*Mar FRAs pct 3.12 vs 3.13 *Dec FRAs pct 3.55 vs 3.57
